name: PortPrint
impact: SMT sibling fingerprints the instruction stream of code protected by execute-only memory or a TEE, identifying cryptographic functions, library versions and which Spectre mitigations are active
mitigation: Disable SMT: port contention requires a sibling thread on the same physical core, so disabling simultaneous multithreading removes the channel
boundary_statement: PortPrint (uASC 2025, CISPA) fingerprints inaccessible code via CPU port contention, verified against execute-only memory, Intel SGX, Intel TDX and AMD SEV, with over 99% accuracy on cryptographic workloads. Mitigation is deployment-side (disable SMT); there is no patch for the microarchitectural channel itself.

Intel-TDX.evidence: Abstract: 'We verify that PortPrint works despite state-of-the-art code protection mechanisms, such as memory protection keys, hypervisor-based XOM, Intel SGX, Intel TDX, and AMD SEV.'

AMD-SEV-SNP.evidence: Abstract: the same verification list includes AMD SEV; the evaluation covers AMD Zen 3. PortPrint 'identifies cryptographic functions, reveals library versions' despite TEE protection.
